card.title: Who the Regime Covers
lines: Applies to Individuals, HUF, AOP, BOI, and AJP.
The provision identifies Assessment Year 2025-26 and Assessment Year 2026-27.
Section 115BAC(1A) governs the default tax regime.

card.title: Charge and Regime
lines: Section 4 provides for the charge of income-tax.
Tax is computed on the Total Income of the relevant previous year.
Section 115BAC(1A) supplies the default-regime slab rates.

narration_ml: ഈ regime-ൽ ആദ്യത്തെ ₹ 4,00,000-ന് Nil rate ആണ്; ₹ 4,00,001 മുതൽ ₹ 12,00,000 വരെയുള്ള തുടർന്നുള്ള slabs-ന് 5%, 10% നിരക്കുകളാണ്.

card.title: Initial Slab Rates
lines: Income up to ₹ 4,00,000 is taxed at Nil rate.
Income from ₹ 4,00,001 to ₹ 8,00,000 is taxed at 5%.
Income from ₹ 8,00,001 to ₹ 12,00,000 is taxed at 10%.

card.title: Upper Slab Rates
lines: Income from ₹ 12,00,001 to ₹ 16,00,000 is taxed at 15%.
Income above ₹ 24,00,000 is taxed at 30%.

narration_ml: Narration-consistent rule പ്രകാരം Resident Individual-ന്റെ Total Income ₹ 12,00,000 കവിയാത്തപ്പോൾ Section 87A പ്രകാരം പരമാവധി ₹ 60,000 rebate ലഭിക്കും.

card.title: Rebate under Section 87A
lines: Available to a Resident Individual under the narration-consistent rule.
The Total Income threshold is ₹ 12,00,000.
The maximum rebate amount is ₹ 60,000.

card.title: Cess and Surcharge
lines: Health and Education Cess is levied at 4% on aggregate income-tax.
The provision states a 25% ceiling for surcharge rates under this regime.
Calculate cess after determining the applicable income-tax and surcharge.

card.title: Uniform Exemption Rule
lines: The basic exemption limit is ₹ 4,00,000.
The same basic exemption applies across age categories.
No higher basic exemption is provided for Senior or Super Senior Citizens under this regime.

card.title: Confirm Regime First
lines: Section 115BAC(1A) is the default regime described in the provision.
The assessee must opt out to use the optional old regime.
Apply the slab and relief rules for the selected regime only.
